heading: Compile errors
text:
## Compile errors [LNOG.9]

| Code | Condition | Paragraph |
|---|---|---|
| LNOG.3.1 | Schema declaration uses `scope logical` anywhere in a program with `logical: false` | LNOG.3.1 |
| LNOG.3.2 | `emit X logical` action in a program with `logical: false` | LNOG.3.2 |

When `logical: false` and `linear_scan: false` are both set, multi-pattern
rules additionally produce LNLS.3.3 errors (no logical-schema anchor
available).  These are reported under LNLS error codes, not LNOG.

All violations are compile errors.  There are no runtime detections.
